rationale: All 17 gold-required entities are surfaced and verifiable against logic_flow evidence: both CAPEC ids (CAPEC-37, CAPEC-639), all 6 must_correlate/must_include_related ATT&CK techniques (T1005, T1039, T1552.001, T1552.003, T1552.004, T1552.006), and all 9 must_include_related mitigations (M1015, M1017, M1022, M1027, M1028, M1041, M1047, M1051, M1057).
